ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio; approximately 85% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels versus 15% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous high-intensity white surface bordered by thick low-intensity black pigmentation along the trailing edge and tips; a distinct dark, vertically-oriented serrated triangular mark is centered at the fluke base (peduncle insertion).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped median notch with an estimated internal angle of 75 degrees and a depth approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across both lobes; the right lobe exhibits higher amplitude peaks and deeper valleys (more jagged) compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve from the median notch extending to the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast circular and elliptical dark-ringed spots (rosette patterns) distributed across the central and outer regions of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct low-intensity linear marks; notably three parallel diagonal scratches on the lower left lobe and multiple short vertical scratches near the fluke base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Active barnacle colonization visible as white, calcified clusters on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes; significant notch-like tissue loss on the right trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive dark 'tree-like' or 'staircase' pigmentation pattern located centrally at the base where the lobes converge.
